run: curl -fsSL "https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/ncurses/ncurses-6.6.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C /tmp && tic -x -o /usr/share/terminfo /tmp/ncurses-6.6/misc/terminfo.src && infocmp -x ghostty | awk 'BEGIN { replaced=0 } /^#/ { print; next } replaced == 0 { print "xterm-ghostty|ghostty|Ghostty terminal emulator,"; replaced=1; next } { print }' | tic -x -o /usr/share/terminfo - && rm -rf /tmp/ncurses-6.6
